map.五险一金明细 使用指南: Five Insurances and Housing Fund Breakdown User Guide
map.输入缴费基数与五险一金各分项比例，分别计算个人与单位每月缴纳明细，比例可自定义，: Enter the contribution base and the ratio for each of the five insurances and the housing fund to compute the monthly employee and employer breakdown; ratios are customizable and results are reference values, with actual contributions per local social insurance policy.
map.个人/单位缴纳明细计算，比例可自定义（参考值，以当地政策为准）: Per-person and per-employer contribution breakdown, with customizable ratios (reference values, subject to local policy)
map.HR 每月核算工资表时，按基数拆出养老、医疗、失业、工伤、生育及公积金的个人与单: When HR computes the monthly payroll, it splits the contribution base into the employee and employer amounts for pension, medical, unemployment, work injury, maternity, and housing fund.
map.员工核对工资条，理解到手与税前差异来源。: Employees check their payslips to understand where the difference between take-home and pre-tax pay comes from.
map.调基或跨统筹区转移时，重新测算单位和个人月缴总额。: When the base is adjusted or you transfer across pooling regions, recalculate the monthly totals for employer and employee.
map.：个人：养老 8%=800、医疗 2%=200、失业 0.5%=50、公积金 1: : Employee: pension 8%=800, medical 2%=200, unemployment 0.5%=50, housing fund 12%=1200 → total 2250; employer pension 16%=1600, medical 9%=900, and so on, with ratios customizable.
map.：若当地上限为社平 3 倍，超基数部分按上限计，工具自动提示封顶。: : If the local upper limit is three times the average social wage, the part above the base is counted at the upper limit, and the tool flags the cap automatically.
map.员工考勤迟到/早退统计报表: Employee attendance late arrival and early departure report
map.养老/失业/工伤等全国有基准区间，医疗与公积金由统筹区自定，工具比例可手动改以贴: Pension, unemployment, and work injury insurance have national baseline ranges, while medical insurance and the housing fund are set by the pooling region; the tool's ratios can be edited manually to match local policy.
map.结果为什么是参考值？: Why Are the Results a Reference Value?
map.因各地比例与上下限年度调整，工具按输入比例计算，实际缴费以社保经办机构核定为准。: Since ratios and upper and lower limits are adjusted annually by locality, the tool computes from the ratios you enter, while actual contributions are as determined by the social insurance agency.
